Config db schema generated by minigraph can’t pass yang validation, yang model does not have 'status' field.
It seems that we need to update yang model or sonic-config-engine.

#### Description

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. Run command 'sonic-cfggen -m tests/sample_graph.xml --print-data'.
2. Use sonic_yang to validate config db schema.

#### Describe the results you received:
Yang validation failed.

#### Describe the results you expected:
Yang validation should pass.

resolution.title: [sonic-cfggen]: Feature should use 'state' to replace 'status'
resolution.description:
Signed-off-by: Gang Lv <EMAIL>

#### Why I did it
ConfigDB schema generated by minigraph parser can't pass yang validation.

#### How I did it
Modify minigraph.py, and use 'state' to replace 'status'.

#### How to verify it
Run UT for sonic-config-engine.
Use minigraph parser to generate ConfigDB schema, and run yang validation.
